description: Everything you have claimed from the vault, for the wallet you signed in with: each asset in real units (grams of gold, SPY shares, USDY), what it was worth when each claim landed and at today's prices, what is waiting to be claimed, and the running totals month by month. A part that could not be read is null, never zero. Read-only, same sign-in as get_my_vault.
name: get_my_timeline
